name: Rocket Fuel - (1g) Live Resin - Melonade
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, straight from the jar. Rocket Fuel Melonade live resin delivers 1 gram of full-spectrum concentrate, extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with — bold, flavorful, and made for dabbing.

Melonade is a sativa-leaning hybrid that crosses Watermelon Zkittlez with Lemon Tree, and the flavor lives up to the name: sweet, juicy melon up front with a bright citrus-lemonade snap and a smooth, refreshing finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — an uplifting, energizing lift that makes it a standout daytime pick for concentrate lovers.

Why you'll love it:

1G live resin — fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Melonade flavor — sweet, juicy melon with a bright citrus-lemonade snap
Jar packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Rocket Fuel Melonade is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
